title: What dashboard "stop chain" means for buying

options.name: Keep current behaviour: stop removes WebSocket listeners only
options.risk: HTTP-polling chains keep buying, Telegram drops still buy on stopped chains, and start adds a second poller (double dispatch).

options.name: Every buy entry point checks the stopped state; stop clears pollers; start is idempotent
options.behavior_impact: A stopped chain makes no new buys from any source; exits and anti-rug continue.
options.risk: Needs the stopped state shared with bot.ts and every entry point covered by a test.

options.name: Remove per-chain stop/start and rely on the global pause
options.risk: Loses the ability to halt one chain while others trade.

recommendation: stop-means-no-new-buys. Until then, use the global pause to halt buying.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). This card covers S0/S1 capital findings, which cannot rest on the default: until it is decided and fixed it blocks the live re-entry gate.
behavior_impact: Decides whether the per-chain stop control actually stops buying.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
